info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Bournon Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Bournon Drill Details Catalog API enables businesses to create and manage detailed listings for Bournon drill products. This API facilitates the submission of essential specifications, features, and pricing information, ensuring that product data is up-to-date and comprehensive. It is particularly valuable for e-commerce platforms or inventory management systems that need to present accurate drill specifications to end customers. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce developers looking to streamline catalog updates and maintain product visibility.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information about a Bournon drill. It receives specific parameters required to define the drill's characteristics, enabling effective management and utilization of the drill in operational contexts.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details for the Bournon drill operation. It should include all relevant parameters and settings specific to the drill's configuration and requirements.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details.

CreateCatalogBournonDrillDetailRequest.title: Bournon Drill Request Body

bournon_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Bournon drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The amount of Bournon drills being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Bournon drill.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the request.

items.description: A tag representing a characteristic or classification of the request.

CreateCatalogBournonDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating Bournon drill operations.

CreateCatalogBournonDrillDetailResponse_.title: Bournon Drill Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating the outcome.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record created or processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria during processing.

warnings.description: A list of warnings generated during the operation, if any.

items.description: A warning message regarding the operation.
